scope_of_this_release: Something I Noticed (commercial_signal) only. Supplier Request remains frozen at R47 behavior, re-verified via its full dedicated test suite (22/22 passing) as part of this validation, not modified in any way during R48.
major_architectural_changes_in_r48: Evidence gate fix: recognizes OTIF, defect-rate, and concentration comparisons (not spend-only) as valid signal evidence.

Multi-dimensional signal detection: dimensions (spend/volume, OTIF, defect, concentration, specification change, market divergence) collected as a list, not a single if/elif match -- headline and materiality genuinely combine multiple present dimensions.

Generalized competing-explanations engine: two universal hypotheses (one-off/time-limited event; data or reporting error) generated once, generically, for every dimension with a real calculated delta -- not hand-written per signal type.

Evidence-derived investigation-value scoring: feasibility, decision impact (magnitude-based, not binary), and status combined via a single scoring function -- no per-dimension hardcoded priority (e.g. no 'OTIF always outranks commercial'), verified by a test specifically designed to break such a rule if one existed.
Explicit contradiction detection: calculated evidence vs. stated claims (price direction, OTIF direction), kept visibly separate from ordinary hypotheses in both the API and the frontend.

Decision-relevant uncertainty: a dimension with an already-resolved, non-generic explanation has its residual generic questions demoted to non-decision-relevant, rather than every technically-open UNKNOWN forcing investigation.
Explicit decision state (ACT_NOW / INVESTIGATE / WATCH), derived from evidence sufficiency, material contradictions, and decision-relevant unresolved hypotheses.

Generalized impact representation: absolute dollar exposure computed directly from a category's own spend and growth evidence, replacing the prior scenario_annual_impact mechanism borrowed from Supplier Request's requested_change_percent field (which most observation-only signals never carry).

Structured, LLM-based free-text routing (classify_case_mode_from_observation), replacing a five-word keyword list, used only when no explicit mode is supplied and provably never invoked when mode is explicit -- Supplier Request's routing is unreachable through this code path.

known_limitations: The 'immaterial contradiction should not block action' case is NOT solved. Every contradiction this engine detects is currently treated as material -- there is no distinction between a large, consequential conflict and a genuinely trivial one. Explicitly not faked with an invented magnitude threshold; left as an open, named gap.
The feasibility-vs-decision-impact ordering is a designed hierarchy (feasibility checked before impact), not a value derived with zero human judgment -- documented as such in the code, not hidden.

The hypothesis catalogue, while now generalized (two universal hypotheses generated per dimension rather than per-signal-type hand-written branches), still only has ONE type-specific, non-generic hypothesis set for the spend/volume dimension (average-unit-price, mix-shift, specification-attribution). OTIF, defect, and concentration currently only ever produce the two generic hypotheses.

The routing classifier (classify_case_mode_from_observation) has never been verified against a live model -- no real Anthropic API key exists anywhere in this environment or session. Its mechanism, fallback safety, and non-interference with Supplier Request are proven; live judgment quality is not.
No live model call of any kind has been made in this entire R48 body of work. All 731 tests are deterministic and mock-based, consistent with every prior release in this engagement.

No genuine browser automation exists in this environment; frontend validation used a real running server process and direct HTTP/HTML inspection, not actual browser rendering, console error capture, or visual layout checking.
unresolved_technical_debt: Internal hypothesis/contradiction tags (_generic, _dimension, _gates_others) require explicit stripping before every API response -- confirmed done, but any future dimension type added to this profile must remember to follow the same pattern or risk a leak.

Contradiction phrase-matching (price/OTIF direction claims) is narrow, hand-built text patterns -- the same class of fragility the original routing keyword list had, just smaller in scope and only used as a detector, not a router.

dimension_established_materiality is a binary True/False signal reused across headline, materiality-text, investigation-value scoring, and now decision-state logic -- a single shared concept doing several jobs, which kept the implementation coherent but means a future change to what 'established materiality' means for one purpose could unintentionally affect the others.
